creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The release preflight at release:285 refuses any uncommitted change besides the release notes. A factory run leaves its board edits in .kan/ uncommitted in the owner's checkout on purpose (Foreman's factory-board-commits decision), so every factory run allowed to release stops there: muster-1119-iris did on 2026-11-20, with 0.30.0 notes written and nothing bumped.

The owner asked on 2026-11-20 for the release to go ahead when only .kan/ is dirty. The release commits nothing under .kan/, so leaving those edits alone is safe. Exclude .kan/ from that check, and from any other clean-tree check the script makes, and say so in the script's comment and in the release docs if they describe the check.
title: ./release refuses to run while only board edits are uncommitted
